decision_candidates.title: Freeze ARGOS as a reference track
decision_candidates.decision: Preserve ARGOS as partial methodological support and prohibit further tuning or winner selection on its exposed outer partition.
decision_candidates.why: The reference-track component questions were sufficient for design decisions, while more tuning would have diminishing value and threaten confirmation boundaries.
decision_candidates.consequence: ARGOS informs the current architecture but is not the current method, an exact reproduction, or a performance winner.

decision_candidates.title: Separate detector-only, Rule-only, and combined evaluation
decision_candidates.decision: Evaluate detector-only, Rule-only, and combined arms under a fixed comparable protocol before making any combination-superiority claim.
decision_candidates.why: ARGOS used directional FN/FP correction, but source structure alone could not establish utility or superiority.
decision_candidates.consequence: The later HAI INNER program created D0, D1, and D2 as separate frozen arms; current D2 improvement remains unsupported.

decision_candidates.title: Prioritize Rule-only visibility before fusion
decision_candidates.decision: Execute D1 Rule-only as its own bounded result before D0 and D2, and preserve its prediction artifact for later comparison.
decision_candidates.why: Rule-only utility must be independently observable rather than hidden inside detector fusion.
decision_candidates.consequence: D1 was executed first; its event complementarity and high false-alarm cost remain distinct from combined utility.
decision_candidates.historical_link_caution: The repository proves the 2026-08-20 decision. Attribution of its priority specifically to 2026-08-04 professor feedback remains user-context supported rather than independently Git-proven.

decision_candidates.title: Use pairwise temporal relations first
decision_candidates.decision: Use a bounded pairwise continuous-step delayed-response family for the first HAI MVP; defer multi-stage, tree, hierarchy, and feedback-loop relations.
decision_candidates.why: A pairwise first unit is easier to profile, bind, verify, execute, and compare without claiming unsupported complex dynamics.
decision_candidates.consequence: The current architecture uses source-target pair evidence and explicitly leaves more complex relation families outside the first scope.
decision_candidates.feedback_link_caution: The pairwise protocol freeze predates the user-context August 4 feedback. Treat that feedback as reinforcement or scope clarification unless a source proves a different chronology.

decision_candidates.title: Make deterministic code the final verifier authority
decision_candidates.decision: An LLM may propose bounded structure, but deterministic code separately validates schema, evidence, parameters, split, runtime, and claim boundaries and retains final admission authority.
decision_candidates.why: Prompt-only control and LLM-authored variables, thresholds, imports, and control flow were insufficient for semantic control, provenance, and reproducibility.
decision_candidates.consequence: The current verifier is not an LLM reviewer and does not scientifically prove causal or performance validity.

decision_candidates.title: Separate numeric authority from LLM generation
decision_candidates.decision: Derive numeric references deterministically from authorized normal data and prohibit LLM-authored scientific thresholds or parameter approval.
decision_candidates.why: The ARGOS audit distinguished LLM-written rule thresholds from label-selected evaluation thresholds and found no deterministic rule-threshold calibration in the pinned route.
decision_candidates.consequence: Current proposals bind to versioned normal-derived references instead of inventing numbers.

decision_candidates.title: Treat GDN output as candidate evidence
decision_candidates.decision: Use an upstream-aligned learned graph to rank candidate pairs; do not treat GDN edges or attention weights as confirmed physical, causal, or final relation evidence.
decision_candidates.why: Candidate generation and normal temporal relation confirmation are separate evidence layers.
decision_candidates.consequence: META, STAT, and GDN remain separate discovery arms merged by unscored provenance-preserving union; downstream profiling determines supported temporal relations.
decision_candidates.feedback_link_caution: The current governance is repository-proven; the exact 2026-08-04 professor wording about GDN extraction is user-context only.

decision_candidates.title: Keep current fixed-rule runtime LLM-free
decision_candidates.decision: Use a deterministic LLM-free R0 runtime for frozen rules. Any alternate online/runtime LLM comparison is a separate conditional future experiment and is not current runtime authority.
decision_candidates.why: Final evaluation must be reproducible and trace-bound; LLM proposal and deterministic execution are separate phases.
decision_candidates.consequence: The current D1 runtime has no LLM. Historical wording that runtime LLM was left open must not be read as authorization for the current path.

decision_candidates.title: Use agentic terminology narrowly
decision_candidates.decision: Describe T2 technically as bounded verifier-feedback construction; do not claim an autonomous multi-agent system or agentic superiority.
decision_candidates.why: The deterministic verifier, not an agent, holds final authority, and the current cohort does not establish feedback advantage.
decision_candidates.consequence: Graph-Guided and Agentic remain provisional labels; claims must name the bounded construction mechanism and evidence layer.
decision_candidates.feedback_link_caution: The repository establishes the conservative current terminology, but not a verbatim professor statement using the phrase multi-agent.

decision_candidates.title: Keep validation roles and held-out claims separate
decision_candidates.decision: Separate construction evidence, validation selection, INNER utility, and one-way held-out confirmation; do not convert previously exposed or unavailable OUTER evidence into a generalization claim.
decision_candidates.why: The ARGOS audit found label-based validation selection and test evaluation during training iterations, and the current project requires clean staged authority.
decision_candidates.consequence: Current INNER observations remain pilot-only; old OUTER has no scientific outcome; any new held-out study requires independent preregistration.

decision_candidates.title: Keep professor-facing thesis scope decisions pending
decision_candidates.decision: Recommend a thesis-first path while awaiting professor decisions on contribution framing, explanation interface, independent OUTER evaluation, and baseline strength.
decision_candidates.why: The current implementation and pilot support narrow method/contract claims but not general combined performance, held-out generalization, or human explanation usefulness.
decision_candidates.consequence: Do not treat the recommendations as professor-approved and do not automatically start D2 V3, OUTER retry, TSFM/ARTIST, dataset expansion, or a stronger baseline.
